en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own job, salary and arrival date and get the same first-rental cash plan before you sign
en.runTitle: Bengaluru to Dubai: a first studio or 1-bedroom near Business Bay on AED 18,000 a month

fields.label: Nationality, arrival and job-start dates
fields.value: Moving from Bengaluru; the job starts on 1 March 2027

Rent ceiling and cheque preferences
fields.value: About AED 6,500 a month, or the annual equivalent

fields.label: ID and banking status
fields.placeholder: e.g. Emirates ID not yet issued, no UAE bank account

en.template: Plan my first Dubai rental for {arrival}, with {pay}, {office}, {rent} and {idstatus}. Compare studios and modest one-bedrooms using the full fee sheet, realistic commute and current dated listings. Separate opening cash, monthly rent reserves and first-year cash flow; keep an ID-delay temporary-stay backup and clear refund conditions. Flag legal or banking questions for the relevant official/provider. Plan only; do not contact anyone, apply, create accounts, reserve or pay.

phases.title: Read the official rules on cheques, deposits, Ejari and utilities, and check the rental index and Metro access
phases.note: Dubai Land Department and DEWA rules, the rental index and commute options

phases.title: Collect and inspect 12 current listings in four Metro-friendly areas
phases.note: Rent, cheque terms, size and the date each listing was seen
phases.judgment: It would not read a missing fee as a free one: in most listings the deposit, agency fee, admin fee and Ejari charge were simply not stated, so they stay unquantified rather than counted as zero. It also noted a listing whose web address named Building 4 while the page described Building 1.

phases.title: Build the guide and the first-year cash plan, then verify the figures and the page
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed the plan on its own, AED 43,005 to get in the door and then AED 11,100 a month against the AED 18,000 salary, and found it consistent. It also spotted two saved listing captures that were error pages, so they are not treated as evidence.
